paragraphs: Chapter 578
Episode 150. When It's Time to Pay the Price (1)
Dante did not immediately declare his regency the next day. There were issues that needed to be sorted out first.
In an underground villa in the central region of the Empire.
A man was pacing aimlessly in the living room. His pale, drained face and trembling shoulders revealed his anxiety.
He was Tion Hairan, the second son of Ron Hairan and a former knight of Hairan.

The first to betray the Hairan and participate in the emperor's rebellion. He had fled to this underground villa even before the battle at the Sword Emperor's palace ended, along with about fifty knights of the Empire who followed him.
'Dammit, how did it come to this...?'
There were several reasons why he betrayed the Hairan. Despite being a knight, he had never been able to satisfy Ron and had always been overshadowed by his nephew, Dante.

Tion thought all of this was due to a difference in talent. He chose to ignore knowing fully well the efforts Dante had made, born into chaos and with a radical frailty. It was easier to think it was a difference in talent.
When Ron, who seemed likely to maintain his position for the next twenty years, fell due to an internal injury, the emperor made Tion a sweet offer.
He said there was an object called the 'White Stone', and if Tion testified falsely about it in front of the people, he would make him the head of the house after the Hairan was exterminated.
At that time, the emperor seemed to genuinely covet Tion's potential. So, Tion accepted the emperor's proposal without even an hour of contemplation.
Unaware that his family had known about his signs of betrayal and disloyalty and had silently waited for him to return to the right path.
'I thought the Empire would never lose because Zephyr would step in if they were pushed back, but the King of the Black Sea? Why the hell did something like that come out!'
Bang!
The table shattered under Tion's fist, and fragments flew. The knights, who had been watching his mood, coughed awkwardly for no reason.
"Sir Tion... Has there been any contact from His Majesty?"
A knight asked cautiously.
"Would there be? And you idiot, the Emperor is finished. Our only chance of survival now depends on the Imperial Family, not the Emperor."
"But it seems His Majesty hasn't been touched yet. Looking at the situation outside, there are rumors that Dante Hairan will declare his regency soon..."
"Ha, not satisfied with the family, he wants to swallow up the Empire too? My nephew's world has come. If my father were alive, maybe, but that guy!"
Tion yelled, stomping his feet.
"Sir Tion, the Imperial Family has already ignored our contact three times. How about we try to contact His Majesty first?"
"How many times do I have to say that the Emperor is done! Why are you doing this too?"

"Could it be that the reason His Majesty hasn't been caught until now is because he's under the protection of the royal family? Maybe the royal family hasn't given up on His Majesty yet. He might still have a card to turn the situation around. So, we need to have a conversation with His Majesty."
"If you babble one more time that we need to find His Majesty, I'll break your skull...."
Tion, who had been speaking up to that point, met the knight's eyes with a sudden start.
It was because a sudden, ominous feeling took over his mind. Among the knights who followed him, none would talk back like this.
"You... what is it, why do you keep looking for His Majesty? Did you receive any orders from the royal family? Who are you?"
"What are you talking about?"
"Take off your helmet."
"Sir Tion?"
"Take off your helmet! Your obsession with His Majesty seems suspicious. Capture him! He doesn't seem like he'll confess easily!"
Other knights, gauging the mood, slowly approached him. The knight did not take off his helmet for a while, but then he sighed and said,
"This is really not my style."
The knight reached out into the air. Then he gripped something invisible and pulled, and three knights approaching him got cut into pieces like a roughly sliced fish.
Swish!

What he pulled was a thread-shaped dark magic. His face was quickly stained red with blood that spurted out like a fountain, and as soon as he blinked, he realized that the knight had disappeared from his sight.
'Wh, what is this...!'
The knight was suddenly standing behind Tion, holding a dagger to his neck. He had also taken off his helmet, but what was covering his face was a white mask.
The top assassin of the anonymous, Bejen, had infiltrated Tion's underground mansion a week ago.
During that week, Bejen had countless opportunities to kill Tion more than ten thousand times. But he delayed it for two reasons.
First, Emperor Amir Vermont, in case Tion still had a hotline with the emperor, he wanted to find out where the emperor was.
Second, because there was a request from the client.
- Please observe for a few days, and if there is any sign of remorse, capture him alive and bring him to me. As a negative example of the family, I will give him time to repent.
This did not mean that Tion would be spared. It was simply to give him the opportunity to die with some remorse.
Tion had just completely squandered that opportunity.
"A, anonymous...!"
"It seems you really can't contact Amir Vermont. I tried to be patient in the hope that our princess would have less trouble."
"W, wait. If I can contact His Majesty, will you spare me? Then I will contact His Majesty immediately...."
"Unfortunately, that ship has sailed. And it will take some time to find him, but he will definitely die. Because the top assassin of the anonymous is on him."
Swish!
The dagger swiftly and smoothly pierced Tion's throat.
Tion Hairan died on the spot. The remaining knights did not dare to resist Bejen and were scrambling to escape.
However, as Bejen pulled the invisible thread in the air again, they had no choice but to be ruthlessly sliced apart.
"Ugh, ahh!"
"Save me, please!"
In less than 10 seconds, all the remaining knights had breathed their last.
Not a single drop of their blood was on Bejen's body after completing his mission.
Similar incidents were taking place in the main houses, villas, and secret hideouts of the families who sided with the emperor during the first battle at Sword Emperor's Temple.
"Head of the family! It seems Danté Hairan has already begun the purge. Knights from our family at the main house are being assassinated...!"
At the Hallow family's hideout.
They had attacked Hairan by sending the Central Knights, including Skat Hallow, as the Emperor's forces.
The anonymous assassins were also killing the Hallow family. They received a request to kill everyone except for a few of the most competent individuals in the family.
"Puhuhu... So this is how it ends. Well, since we've lost everything, it's fitting to become a vengeful spirit."
At the main house of the Chenderer family.
They, too, had struck Hairan by sending Gloria Chenderer of the Hundred Knights as part of the Emperor's forces.
In this way, families like the Lillistar and Lillistar Magic Corps, Panga, and others who had sided with the Emperor's forces were paying a heavy price, close to annihilation.
The anonymous assassins took their lives without hesitation.
"The world is truly unpredictable. Danté Hairan... I heard he had changed like a demon during the war, but I didn't know he would act this quickly."
The deputy head of the Henser family spoke in a resigned voice. In front of him was another top anonymous assassin, 'An.'
"You're mistaken."
An spoke in a dry voice, looking at the deputy head of the Henser family.
"The person who requested your deaths is not Danté Hairan."
"What?"
"Just saying. It's a story I didn't need to tell you originally, but I thought you might resent the wrong person after your death."
The blade within 'An' cut the deputy head of the Henser family's neck. Behind him lay the dead bodies of the Henser family's magicians, yet not a single drop of blood was on his pure white clothes.
Danté didn't plan to kill them outright. Like giving Tion time to repent and die, he wanted to give them the chance to contribute even a little to the normalization of the empire before dying.
The one who requested the annihilation of the families who sided with the Emperor's army was not Danté, but the royal family.

They were trying to create a pretext to mitigate the damage as much as possible by cutting off the tail. Those detestable mystics valued their own safety more than the normalization of the empire, which was contaminated by chaos.
The royal family genuinely believed that the empire could only be restored if they were in good shape. They believed they still had the power to do so.
'No-name' is a neutral assassin's blade.
As long as they were qualified and could pay a sufficient price, any power or anyone could borrow the blade of 'no-name'.

If the umbrella known as 'Ron Hairan' had continued to exist in the empire, 'no-name' would never have taken the royal family's request. The fact that 'no-name' accepted a request that could potentially disrupt the balance of the empire was purely because Ron was gone.
'No-name' did not accept all of the requests entrusted by the royal family this time.
Among those who stood with the Emperor's army, there was one family.
'No-name' refused the royal family's request to assassinate the remaining leaders of the 'Ferral family'.

To be precise, they did not accept the request because it 'overlapped'. 'No-name' had received a request to protect the Ferral family from assassination for the time being before receiving the royal family's request.

-Kevin Ferral was a trashy character, but in the end, Lord Jonsina Ferral stood on the side of the emperor's army for the people. Although the choice was ultimately wrong... As a knight, as a person. I want to respect Lord Jonsina's life. Please protect them from assassination for the time being.
And so, the Ferral family was able to preserve their lineage from the blade of 'no-name'.
And those who remained in the Ferral family, fortunately, were mostly similar to Jonsina Ferral.
'No-name's' top assassin found Emperor Amir Vermont half a day later.
Amir Vermont was hiding in an unnamed forest in southern Vermont, and he was all alone, without even his personal bodyguards or escorts.
"Hello?"
Yona Runcandel.
The emperor, who raised his head at her smiling and speaking, could sense it.
That death had finally come for him as well.
